articles.title: UK’s FCA to regulate tokenized gold to preserve London’s place as the top hub for bullion
articles.snippet: The FCA said it will 'have more to say on' their approach to tokenization, as it draws up rules to put assets on the blockchain.

articles.title: Hardware wallet sales in Russia more than double as new crypto rules near
articles.snippet: Wildberries’ average price for hardware wallets fell 13% to 7,900 rubles, and M.Video broadened its range of products, though neither retailer identified the driving force behind the renewed demand.

articles.title: Wall Street Is Starting to Treat Data Center Backlash as a Credit Risk
articles.snippet: Banks financing the AI infrastructure boom are now weighing local public opposition alongside permits and costs.

articles.title: Flock Wanted to Turn 350,000 Uber Drivers Into a Nationwide Plate-Scanning Fleet
articles.snippet: A leaked Flock presentation shows the surveillance firm pitching a plan to pull license-plate data from rideshare and delivery drivers.

articles.title: SEC Bought a Billion Airline Records to Track Travelers—Likely Without a Warrant
articles.snippet: The financial regulator subscribed to a global flight database covering more than a billion tickets to monitor activity.
